rawContent: This is not about polling nor about Al Sharpton. It is about what #BlackLivesMatter and the Movement for Black Lives are calling for. 'Canada' is also built on settler colonialism, Anti-Black racism and other forms of racism. #DefundThePolice #ScholarStrikeCanada

It is not an academic problem! It is an urgent social and political one that results in the police killing Black and Indigenous people. Listen to the movements in the streets and to communities of people attacked by the police. #BlackLivesMatter #DefundThePolice #AbolishThePolice
